blurb.en: Draw your own waveforms, stack them into tables, then morph, fold, bitcrush and FM whatever comes out.
blurb.fi: Piirrä omat aaltomuotosi, pinoa ne taulukoiksi ja morffaa, taita ja bittimurskaa lopputulosta, ja lisää FM:ää.
blurb.sv: Rita egna vågformer, stapla dem till tabeller och morfa, vik, bitkrossa och FM:a det som kommer ut.

pull.q: The sound is clean, modern, punchy and detailed thanks to the unit running at 96kHz — quite different to some low bit-rate wavetable oscillators on the market.

quotes.t: Wavetable interpolation is smooth as butter and with the built-in effects you can dirty things up in many different ways.
Drawing your own waveforms on the Graphic VCO feels like a mixed bag... some of the other tools feel awkward, at least with my fat fingers.
quotes.s: Sound On Sound · the honest caveat
